_meta.source: FIESTA worked examples from THE_PATH_20260520.md + council brief tax_math_anchors
_meta.note: Illustrative cases anonymised from Lanka.tax 2024/25 foreign-income filer sample. Names + NIC removed. Numbers are representative of the population, not promises for any individual customer. CEO sign-off required to use live customer testimonial wording.

examples.persona_short: SL software developer, USD 80K from US client
examples.persona_long: Anjana D. (anonymised), 31, married, 1 child. Self-employed software developer based in Colombo, billing one US-based client USD 6,667/month (USD 80K/year). Works from home office (separate room) on co-rented apartment Rs 90K/month.
deductions_claimed_with_fiesta: Home-office portion of rental (50% of Rs 90K x 12 = Rs 540K)
examples.note: Largest saving driver: home-office rental + software subscriptions, both §6(1) wholly+exclusively defensible.

examples.persona_short: SL designer, EUR 45K mix-clients, subcontractor cousin
examples.persona_long: Priya S. (anonymised), 28, single. Graphic + brand designer, freelances for 4 EU clients totalling EUR 45K/year. Outsources illustration to cousin (related party) for EUR 8K/year — DEFAULT-ON related-party disclosure included in FIESTA-generated Service Agreement.
deductions_claimed_with_fiesta: Subcontractor fees to cousin (Rs 2.6M) — related-party disclosure + arms-length pricing memo attached
examples.note: FIESTA's related-party DEFAULT-ON disclosure shields the cousin payment from audit-time challenge.

examples.persona_short: SL accountant, AUD 60K mix (employer + own clients)
examples.persona_long: Nuwan F. (anonymised), 42, married, 2 kids. Senior accountant on AUD 36K retainer with Australian firm + own Sri Lankan client base (Rs 1.8M domestic). Rents home office, claims insurance + ICASL CPD.
deductions_claimed_with_fiesta: Home-office rental (50% of Rs 60K x 12 = Rs 360K)
examples.note: Mix-income filers gain most from FIESTA's per-income-stream Service Agreement templates — each client gets a separate evidence trail.
